independent_primary.definition: mean across seeds of within-seed upper-tail CVaR90(candidate) minus CVaR90(baseline)
independent_primary.method: CSV-only aligned arrays; ascending weighted-tail estimator and separately implemented paired seed/world percentile bootstrap. Experiment metrics/reporting modules were not imported.

limitations: Only three training seeds; percentile intervals provide limited training-variability evidence.
All 15 oracle receipts are checked; this review does not rerun the oracle computation.
Exact saved-weight generation and independent metric replay cover the two primary arms at budget12, all three seeds; every row receives trace, cost and paired-ID checks.
Selection ordering is established from frozen source control flow and retained log/hash evidence, not an external trusted timestamp service.
Linear MAC matching is not backward, optimizer, controller, wall-time or lifecycle compute equivalence.
Utility gradient evidence at updates1and40 does not prove nonzero credit in every group at every update.

Native HEPTA runtime, general stochastic FBSDE, learned identified preference, latent-dependent refinement feedback, natural-data foundation-model performance and dedicated execution remain separate gates.

post_audit_interpretation.basis: Descriptive calculations from the audited per-arm summaries, gradient receipts, and original CSV omission rows. These notes were added after the main audit; no new primary endpoint, policy selection or experiment execution.

generation_depth.interpretation: Every primary-world arm uses depth0. The primary comparison therefore does not establish beneficial iterative refinement, and its MAC reduction comes from input acquisition work rather than different generation depths.

mean_tail_tradeoff.interpretation: CVaR improves while mean external loss and the ambiguity proxy worsen. Omission is a prototype-margin proxy, not an absent modality. This is not uniform quality dominance.

post_audit_interpretation.secondary_interpretation: Joint NDU does not beat joint myopic on the CVaR point estimate, and its tail benefit over joint static is small. The primary pass does not establish the added value of long-horizon continuation or of bounded preference updates.

shift_and_common_error.interpretation: On correlation shift joint NDU has worse CVaR than joint static, and correctness is about0.0972 for every arm. With all sensors sharing the wrong report, every arm has zero semantic correctness despite smaller reconstruction loss for joint-trained generators. General robustness and recovery of unavailable information are not established.

utility_refinement_credit.interpretation: At sampled updates1and40, seeds17and29 have zero utility-only refinement gradient. Seed43 has a tiny nonzero value at update1 and zero at40. Initial-latent and decoder gradients are nonzero. Anchor-driven refinement weight changes cannot be presented as NDU refinement credit.

review_execution_cost.scope: Separate post-run audit including NumPy/Torch imports; excludes final review JSON serialization. Not part of original experiment training or inference cost.

reviewer_role: separate collaborating agent; independent calculations, not external signed attestation
scientific_disposition: Passes the preregistered bounded primary gate.
scope: Read-only completed evidence audit. No training, policy reselection, empirical tuning, source edit, or heldout rerun.
